criterion: which assistant-command intent the utterance expresses, that is what the user wants done

categories.name: Play Media
categories.definition: User wants to start, resume, stop, or control the playback of audio or video content.

categories.name: Media Information
categories.definition: User wants to retrieve information about media content, such as song titles, artists, or movie reviews.

categories.name: Email Management
categories.definition: User wants to send, check, read, reply to, or manage emails.

categories.name: Calendar & Reminders
categories.definition: User wants to set, check, modify, or delete alarms, reminders, or calendar events and meetings.

categories.name: Smart Home & Device Control
categories.definition: User wants to control smart home devices or device settings like volume, power, or lighting.

categories.name: General Information & Knowledge
categories.definition: User wants to retrieve facts, definitions, news, weather, stock prices, directions, or other general knowledge.

categories.name: Travel & Navigation
categories.definition: User wants to find, book, or get information about travel tickets, schedules, or specific navigation routes for travel.

categories.name: Shopping & Ordering
categories.definition: User wants to order goods or services, such as food or tickets for events.

categories.name: List Management
categories.definition: User wants to create, add items to, remove items from, or view various types of lists.

categories.name: Social Media Interaction
categories.definition: User wants to post, tweet, or interact with social media platforms.

categories.name: App Control
categories.definition: User wants to open or interact with specific applications on a device.

categories.name: Assistant Self-Reference
categories.definition: User asks questions about the assistant itself, its capabilities, or identity.
